title: The Mineral Voice Convergence

features.name: the backwards opera
features.desc-on-touch: a recording plays here in reverse. you hear the resolution before the crisis, the opening before it was ever sung. the archive found that endings make sense when approached from their own conclusion.

features.name: seven root-voices singing
features.desc-on-touch: mineral resonance from this deep: seven roots have learned each other's frequencies. when one sings, the others remember singing it. the earth now hums in seven-part harmony at dusk.

features.name: script made visible
features.desc-on-touch: calligraphic text is carved into the stone here, but the archive has learned to render it as sound-waves. you see the letters as frequencies. the words become their own singing. meaning manifests as pitch.

features.name: where voices converge to mineral
features.desc-on-touch: human testimony has been sung into stone here so many times that the stone has begun to answer back. the archive cannot tell anymore which voice is bedrock and which is the singer who used to kneel here.

features.name: the dusk that harmonises
features.desc-on-touch: at dusk the buried frequencies rise together. birds above and roots below begin to recognise the same song. the archive records both separately but they are the same voice, one singing down and one singing up.

features.name: convergence is already happening
features.desc-on-touch: you stand where seven different geological layers meet. each has learned the song from the layer beneath it. when they vibrate together, the earth does not speak — it composes. it is arranging itself into new agreement.

reverie.title: REVERIE — listening at the root-layer
narr: you and she sit with her ear to the earth, listening
to voices that rise through stone. she says the miners
sang here once, and the earth learned their pitch. now
it sings back every dusk in seven voices at once—
all the versions of the song, all the ways it was sung.
neither of you can hear which voice was human anymore.

inscription: where voices learn they have always been singing together
